      <description>European Commission Press release Brussels, 01 May 2026 The first-ever EU-Armenia Summit will take place on 4-5 May, in Yerevan. This marks a significant step forward in their relations, reaffirming the European Union's strong commitment to Armenia's sovereignty, resilience and reform agenda. </description>

    <item>
      <title>Commission opens consultation on draft of new Merger Guidelines</title>
      <link>https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/detail/en/ip_26_918</link>
      <description>European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Apr 2026 The European Commission has launched today a public consultation inviting comments on the draft of the new EU Merger Guidelines. These will replace the current Horizontal Merger Guidelines and the Non-Horizontal Merger Guidelines. This marks the most significant reform in EU merger control of the past two decades.</description>
